oldferry_sailor.text: Before the bridge opened in 1966, cars crossed the Severn on the Aust to Beachley ferry. I took thousands of them over, and a few of them came back.
A Clawcastle is a walking fortress. It rarely fights. The other rock pool folk simply get out of the way.
Bayrunners race the boats. They win every time and never gloat. Well, hardly ever.
